hero.title: Richter
hero.subtitle: Sound Design / Short Film / Field Recording, Synthesis, Foley, Orchestral Score
about.text: Sound design for a student earthquake film. The constraint: no commercial sample libraries allowed. I recorded all foley from scratch with a Zoom H6 and basic gear — footsteps on wood, concrete, carpet, door sounds, paper, cloth. Built tension drones and risers in Vital, ReaSynth, and TAL Noisemaker. Wrote a short orchestral cue with strings and brass, timed to scene cuts. Final mix in Reaper with volume and EQ automation to keep dialogue clear over the earthquake rumble.

approach.title: Approach
approach.field_desc: Recorded all ambiences and room tones with a Zoom H6. No library fallbacks — every texture is original.
approach.synth_desc: Built tension drones and risers in Vital, ReaSynth, TAL Noisemaker. The alarm sound is pure synthesis — no recordings.
approach.foley_desc: Footsteps on three surfaces, doors, paper, cloth. Recorded, layered, and processed in Cubase with granular stretching for the earthquake moments.
approach.mix_desc: The earthquake rumble kept burying the dialogue. Used EQ automation and sidechain ducking in Reaper to keep speech intelligible throughout.
